title: feat(triage): execute automatic Dos inside the triage run
body:
On an automated repository, Dos marked automatic were still only suggested; a person had to click each one. The triage run now executes them itself.

## What changed

- GitHub tool 0.4.0: Do execution (`executeDo`, markers, satisfied checks) moves into the tool, and a new write tool `github_execute_do_auto` runs one Do with validated arguments. It cannot merge; close only runs for a close Do; labels are add-only; a close or comment on a head that moved is refused.
- Workflow: `evaluate → execute → mirror` on both paths. `execute` is a deterministic director (no inference) because actions cannot reach a bound credential on this Interchange pin. It runs only on automated repositories, only automatic Dos, sequentially, at most 10 per run (the rest stay pending), and never on a verdict the hub treats as unsettled (a model check not asked, judge skipped or over budget, mergeability pending). Agent and derived-label Dos are skipped with a reason; not-runnable Dos are skipped, not failed.
- Idempotency: each comment carries a per-effect marker and every write checks GitHub first, so a later run on the same head reports satisfied and writes nothing.
- Hub: one shared settledness predicate for the hub and the workflow; the reconciler records each executed Do in `corbits_triage_do_run` with source `workflow` in one insert-or-settle statement, also from runs that failed after executing, and leaves portal-settled rows alone.

## Verification

- `bun run check`; `bun --conditions=intx-src test packages/triage-workflows packages/triage-contracts packages/github-tool apps/hub/src/github` and `apps/hub/src/server.test.ts`.
- Live local sidecar run against a fake GitHub that keeps comments: an automated repository with an automatic comment Do on a failing title rule posted the comment once on each of four PRs plus the verdict comment; a second run on the same head read the comments and posted nothing; four rows recorded, one per Do, source workflow, one attempt each.

Closes CL-XXXX
author: TheGreatAxios

feat(github-tool): run a triage Do without approval
